transactions.title: Payment history
transactions.description: Every payment you have made on the hub, newest first.
transactions.emptyDescription: When you buy a plan, the payment shows up here.

detail.title: Payment details
detail.pendingDescription: Finish the payment in Midtrans. This page updates once Midtrans confirms it.
detail.pendingExpired: The payment window has closed. If you paid, the status will update shortly; otherwise it will expire.
detail.refunded: This payment was refunded, and access for it has ended.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.oneTimeNotice: One-time payment, no automatic renewal. Access starts once the payment is confirmed.
checkout.securedBy: Payments are processed securely by Midtrans.
checkout.freePlan: Free plans don't need a payment.
checkout.snapNotConfigured: Midtrans is not configured (NEXT_PUBLIC_MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY). The hosted payment page will open instead.
checkout.planUnavailableDescription: It may no longer be sold. Choose another plan of the product.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.conflict: This plan can't be bought right now.
errors.upstream: Payment could not be started, please try again.

checkout.processingDescription: We're waiting for Midtrans to confirm your payment. This usually takes a few seconds.
checkout.pendingDescription: We haven't received a confirmation yet. Complete the payment and this page will update.

instructions.qris: Scan the QRIS code in the Midtrans window with your banking or e-wallet app.
instructions.va: Transfer the exact amount to the virtual account number shown by Midtrans.
instructions.generic: Complete the payment in the Midtrans window.
instructions.keepPage: Keep this page open, or come back later — the status updates automatically.
instructions.history: You can always find this payment in your payment history.

checkout.successDescription: {{product}} {{plan}} is now active on your account.
checkout.failedDescription: The payment was declined, cancelled, or expired. You were not charged for this order.

howItWorks.one: Confirm the plan and open the Midtrans payment window.
howItWorks.two: Pay with QRIS, virtual account, e-wallet, or card.
howItWorks.three: Access starts as soon as Midtrans confirms the payment.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Your access to each product. Renew any time — early renewals never lose paid days.
subscriptions.emptyDescription: Pick a plan to unlock paid features in a product.
subscriptions.planRetired: This plan is no longer sold.
